name: pastel-yellow-fitness-grid
image_purpose: fitness campaign and activewear lookbook grid

prompt.project_info: Create a premium 2x2 fitness editorial collage using four consistent poses and one adult model in pastel-yellow activewear.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman using the required approved-adult face reference, preserving identity and facial features across all frames. She wears a light pastel-yellow athletic sports bra, seamless leggings, matching running sneakers, white crew socks, pastel-yellow over-ear fitness headphones, and uses pastel-yellow coated dumbbells in the standing pose.
prompt.composition_elements: 2x2 grid with thin gutters and no outer border: floor bicycle-crunch pose, deep forward-fold stretch, kneeling back-stretch pose, and standing dumbbell pose. Minimal white or light-beige studio background, same woman and styling in every frame.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft high-end fitness studio lighting, even highlights, clean natural shadows, soft pastel-yellow and warm-neutral palette, premium activewear editorial mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 4:5 portrait grid, 50mm lens, sharp subject with subtle depth, realistic performance fabric, hands, dumbbells, headphones, and sneakers, no logos or text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Premium fitness editorial 2x2 grid using the required approved-adult face reference, preserving the same adult woman identity, face, styling, and proportions in all frames. Light pastel-yellow athletic sports bra, seamless leggings, matching running sneakers, white crew socks, pastel-yellow over-ear fitness headphones, and pastel-yellow coated dumbbells in the standing pose. Four reference poses: floor bicycle crunch, deep forward-fold stretch, kneeling back stretch, and standing holding dumbbells. Minimal clean white or light-beige studio, soft high-end fitness lighting, even highlights, clean shadows, 50mm lens, realistic performance fabric and natural anatomy, 4:5 premium activewear campaign.
